I've successfully navigated to the Blueberry Scones recipe on Coded Culinary! Here's the recipe:

## Blueberry Scones
**Yield:** 8 scones | **Prep time:** 15 min | **Bake time:** 20 min

### Ingredients
- 2 cups all-purpose flour
- 1/3 cup granulated sugar
- 1 tbsp baking powder
- 1/2 tsp salt
- 1/2 cup unsalted butter, cold and cubed
- 3/4 cup fresh blueberries
- 1/2 cup heavy cream
- 1 large egg
- 1 tsp vanilla extract

### Instructions
1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
3. Cut in cold butter using a pastry cutter or fork until mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
4. Gently fold in blueberries.
5. In a separate bowl, whisk cream, egg, and vanilla. Stir into dry ingredients until just combined.
6. Turn dough onto floured surface, shape into a 1-inch thick circle, and cut into 8 wedges.
7. Place wedges on prepared sheet, brush with cream, and sprinkle with coarse sugar.
8. Bake 18-22 minutes until golden. Cool before serving.

### Tips
For flaky scones, keep ingredients cold and avoid over-mixing. Serve with clotted cream or lemon glaze.

Enjoy your baking! 🫐🥐

I've successfully navigated to the Blueberry Scones recipe on Coded Culinary! Here's the recipe:

## Blueberry Scones
**Yield:** 8 scones | **Prep time:** 15 min | **Bake time:** 20 min

### Ingredients
- 2 cups all-purpose flour
- 1/3 cup granulated sugar
- 1 tbsp baking powder
- 1/2 tsp salt
- 1/2 cup unsalted butter, cold and cubed
- 3/4 cup fresh blueberries
- 1/2 cup heavy cream
- 1 large egg
- 1 tsp vanilla extract

### Instructions
1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
3. Cut in cold butter using a pastry cutter or fork until mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
4. Gently fold in blueberries.
5. In a separate bowl, whisk cream, egg, and vanilla. Stir into dry ingredients until just combined.
6. Turn dough onto floured surface, shape into a 1-inch thick circle, and cut into 8 wedges.
7. Place wedges on prepared sheet, brush with cream, and sprinkle with coarse sugar.
8. Bake 18-22 minutes until golden. Cool before serving.

### Tips
For flaky scones, keep ingredients cold and avoid over-mixing. Serve with clotted cream or lemon glaze.

Enjoy your baking! 🫐🥐

result.title: Blueberry Scone Recipe | Coded Culinary
result.content:
Blueberry Scones

Yield: 8 scones | Prep time: 15 min | Bake time: 20 min

Ingredients

  • 2 cups all-purpose flour
  • 1/3 cup granulated sugar
  • 1 tbsp baking powder
  • 1/2 tsp salt
  • 1/2 cup unsalted butter, cold and cubed
  • 3/4 cup fresh blueberries
  • 1/2 cup heavy cream
  • 1 large egg
  • 1 tsp vanilla extract

Instructions

  1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
  2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
  3. Cut in cold butter using a pastry cutter or fork until mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
  4. Gently fold in blueberries.
  5. In a separate bowl, whisk cream, egg, and vanilla. Stir into dry ingredients until just combined.
  6. Turn dough onto floured surface, shape into a 1-inch thick circle, and cut into 8 wedges.
  7. Place wedges on prepared sheet, brush with cream, and sprinkle with coarse sugar.
  8. Bake 18-22 minutes until golden. Cool before serving.

Tips

For flaky scones, keep ingredients cold and avoid over-mixing. Serve with clotted cream or lemon glaze.

© 2026 Coded Culinary | Recipe last updated: 2025-11-15

I've successfully navigated to the Blueberry Scones recipe on Coded Culinary! Here's the recipe:

## Blueberry Scones
**Yield:** 8 scones | **Prep time:** 15 min | **Bake time:** 20 min

### Ingredients
- 2 cups all-purpose flour
- 1/3 cup granulated sugar
- 1 tbsp baking powder
- 1/2 tsp salt
- 1/2 cup unsalted butter, cold and cubed
- 3/4 cup fresh blueberries
- 1/2 cup heavy cream
- 1 large egg
- 1 tsp vanilla extract

### Instructions
1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
3. Cut in cold butter using a pastry cutter or fork until mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
4. Gently fold in blueberries.
5. In a separate bowl, whisk cream, egg, and vanilla. Stir into dry ingredients until just combined.
6. Turn dough onto floured surface, shape into a 1-inch thick circle, and cut into 8 wedges.
7. Place wedges on prepared sheet, brush with cream, and sprinkle with coarse sugar.
8. Bake 18-22 minutes until golden. Cool before serving.

### Tips
For flaky scones, keep ingredients cold and avoid over-mixing. Serve with clotted cream or lemon glaze.

Enjoy your baking! 🫐

**Blueberry Scones**
*Yield: 8 scones | Prep time: 15 min | Bake time: 20 min*

**Ingredients:**
*   2 cups all-purpose flour
*   1/3 cup granulated sugar
*   1 tbsp baking powder
*   1/2 tsp salt
*   1/2 cup unsalted butter, cold and cubed
*   3/4 cup fresh blueberries
*   1/2 cup heavy cream
*   1 large egg
*   1 tsp vanilla extract

**Instructions:**
1.  Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
2.  In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
3.  Cut in cold butter using a pastry cutter or fork until mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
4.  Gently fold in blueberries.
5.  In a separate bowl, whisk cream, egg, and vanilla. Stir into dry ingredients until just combined.
6.  Turn dough onto floured surface, shape into a 1-inch thick circle, and cut into 8 wedges.
7.  Place wedges on prepared sheet, brush with cream, and sprinkle with coarse sugar.
8.  Bake 18-22 minutes until golden. Cool before serving.

**Tips:**
For flaky scones, keep ingredients cold and avoid over-mixing. Serve with clotted cream or lemon glaze.

data.title: Blueberry Scone Recipe | Coded Culinary
data.content:
Blueberry Scones

Yield: 8 scones | Prep time: 15 min | Bake time: 20 min

Ingredients

  • 2 cups all-purpose flour
  • 1/3 cup granulated sugar
  • 1 tbsp baking powder
  • 1/2 tsp salt
  • 1/2 cup unsalted butter, cold and cubed
  • 3/4 cup fresh blueberries
  • 1/2 cup heavy cream
  • 1 large egg
  • 1 tsp vanilla extract

Instructions

  1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
  2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
  3. Cut in cold butter using a pastry cutter or fork until mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
  4. Gently fold in blueberries.
  5. In a separate bowl, whisk cream, egg, and vanilla. Stir into dry ingredients until just combined.
  6. Turn dough onto floured surface, shape into a 1-inch thick circle, and cut into 8 wedges.
  7. Place wedges on prepared sheet, brush with cream, and sprinkle with coarse sugar.
  8. Bake 18-22 minutes until golden. Cool before serving.

Tips

For flaky scones, keep ingredients cold and avoid over-mixing. Serve with clotted cream or lemon glaze.

I've successfully navigated to the Blueberry Scones recipe on Coded Culinary! Here's the recipe:

## Blueberry Scones
**Yield:** 8 scones | **Prep time:** 15 min | **Bake time:** 20 min

### Ingredients
- 2 cups all-purpose flour
- 1/3 cup granulated sugar
- 1 tbsp baking powder
- 1/2 tsp salt
- 1/2 cup unsalted butter, cold and cubed
- 3/4 cup fresh blueberries
- 1/2 cup heavy cream
- 1 large egg
- 1 tsp vanilla extract

### Instructions
1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
3. Cut in cold butter using a pastry cutter or fork until mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
4. Gently fold in blueberries.
5. In a separate bowl, whisk cream, egg, and vanilla. Stir into dry ingredients until just combined.
6. Turn dough onto floured surface, shape into a 1-inch thick circle, and cut into 8 wedges.
7. Place wedges on prepared sheet, brush with cream, and sprinkle with coarse sugar.
8. Bake 18-22 minutes until golden. Cool before serving.

### Tips
For flaky scones, keep ingredients cold and avoid over-mixing. Serve with clotted cream or lemon glaze.

Enjoy your baking! 🫐

result.content:
Blueberry Scones

Yield: 8 scones | Prep time: 15 min | Bake time: 20 min

Ingredients

  • 2 cups all-purpose flour
  • 1/3 cup granulated sugar
  • 1 tbsp baking powder
  • 1/2 tsp salt
  • 1/2 cup unsalted butter, cold and cubed
  • 3/4 cup fresh blueberries
  • 1/2 cup heavy cream
  • 1 large egg
  • 1 tsp vanilla extract

Instructions

  1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
  2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
  3. Cut in cold butter using a pastry cutter or fork until mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
  4. Gently fold in blueberries.
  5. In a separate bowl, whisk cream, egg, and vanilla. Stir into dry ingredients until just combined.
  6. Turn dough onto floured surface, shape into a 1-inch thick circle, and cut into 8 wedges.
  7. Place wedges on prepared sheet, brush with cream, and sprinkle with coarse sugar.
  8. Bake 18-22 minutes until golden. Cool before serving.

Tips

For flaky scones, keep ingredients cold and avoid over-mixing. Serve with clotted cream or lemon glaze.

I've successfully navigated to the Blueberry Scones recipe on Coded Culinary. Here's the recipe:

## Blueberry Scones
**Yield:** 8 scones | **Prep time:** 15 min | **Bake time:** 20 min

### Ingredients
- 2 cups all-purpose flour
- 1/3 cup granulated sugar
- 1 tbsp baking powder
- 1/2 tsp salt
- 1/2 cup unsalted butter, cold and cubed
- 3/4 cup fresh blueberries
- 1/2 cup heavy cream
- 1 large egg
- 1 tsp vanilla extract

### Instructions
1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
3. Cut in cold butter using a pastry cutter or fork until mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
4. Gently fold in blueberries.
5. In a separate bowl, whisk cream, egg, and vanilla. Stir into dry ingredients until just combined.
6. Turn dough onto floured surface, shape into a 1-inch thick circle, and cut into 8 wedges.
7. Place wedges on prepared sheet, brush with cream, and sprinkle with coarse sugar.
8. Bake 18-22 minutes until golden. Cool before serving.

### Tips
For flaky scones, keep ingredients cold and avoid over-mixing. Serve with clotted cream or lemon glaze.

I've successfully navigated to the Blueberry Scones recipe on Coded Culinary! Here's the recipe:

## Blueberry Scones
**Yield:** 8 scones | **Prep time:** 15 min | **Bake time:** 20 min

### Ingredients
- 2 cups all-purpose flour
- 1/3 cup granulated sugar
- 1 tbsp baking powder
- 1/2 tsp salt
- 1/2 cup unsalted butter, cold and cubed
- 3/4 cup fresh blueberries
- 1/2 cup heavy cream
- 1 large egg
- 1 tsp vanilla extract

### Instructions
1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
3. Cut in cold butter using a pastry cutter or fork until mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
4. Gently fold in blueberries.
5. In a separate bowl, whisk cream, egg, and vanilla. Stir into dry ingredients until just combined.
6. Turn dough onto floured surface, shape into a 1-inch thick circle, and cut into 8 wedges.
7. Place wedges on prepared sheet, brush with cream, and sprinkle with coarse sugar.
8. Bake 18-22 minutes until golden. Cool before serving.

### Tips
For flaky scones, keep ingredients cold and avoid over-mixing. Serve with clotted cream or lemon glaze.

Enjoy your baking!

result.title: Blueberry Scone Recipe | Coded Culinary
result.content:
Blueberry Scones

Yield: 8 scones | Prep time: 15 min | Bake time: 20 min

Ingredients

  • 2 cups all-purpose flour
  • 1/3 cup granulated sugar
  • 1 tbsp baking powder
  • 1/2 tsp salt
  • 1/2 cup unsalted butter, cold and cubed
  • 3/4 cup fresh blueberries
  • 1/2 cup heavy cream
  • 1 large egg
  • 1 tsp vanilla extract

Instructions

  1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
  2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
  3. Cut in cold butter using a pastry cutter or fork until mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
  4. Gently fold in blueberries.
  5. In a separate bowl, whisk cream, egg, and vanilla. Stir into dry ingredients until just combined.
  6. Turn dough onto floured surface, shape into a 1-inch thick circle, and cut into 8 wedges.
  7. Place wedges on prepared sheet, brush with cream, and sprinkle with coarse sugar.
  8. Bake 18-22 minutes until golden. Cool before serving.

Tips

For flaky scones, keep ingredients cold and avoid over-mixing. Serve with clotted cream or lemon glaze.

I've successfully navigated to the Blueberry Scones recipe on Coded Culinary! Here's the recipe:

## Blueberry Scones
**Yield:** 8 scones | **Prep time:** 15 min | **Bake time:** 20 min

### Ingredients
- 2 cups all-purpose flour
- 1/3 cup granulated sugar
- 1 tbsp baking powder
- 1/2 tsp salt
- 1/2 cup unsalted butter, cold and cubed
- 3/4 cup fresh blueberries
- 1/2 cup heavy cream
- 1 large egg
- 1 tsp vanilla extract

### Instructions
1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
3. Cut in cold butter using a pastry cutter or fork until mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
4. Gently fold in blueberries.
5. In a separate bowl, whisk cream, egg, and vanilla. Stir into dry ingredients until just combined.
6. Turn dough onto floured surface, shape into a 1-inch thick circle, and cut into 8 wedges.
7. Place wedges on prepared sheet, brush with cream, and sprinkle with coarse sugar.
8. Bake 18-22 minutes until golden. Cool before serving.

### Tips
For flaky scones, keep ingredients cold and avoid over-mixing. Serve with clotted cream or lemon glaze.

Enjoy your baking!

result.title: Blueberry Scone Recipe | Coded Culinary
result.content:
Blueberry Scones

Yield: 8 scones | Prep time: 15 min | Bake time: 20 min

Ingredients

  • 2 cups all-purpose flour
  • 1/3 cup granulated sugar
  • 1 tbsp baking powder
  • 1/2 tsp salt
  • 1/2 cup unsalted butter, cold and cubed
  • 3/4 cup fresh blueberries
  • 1/2 cup heavy cream
  • 1 large egg
  • 1 tsp vanilla extract

Instructions

  1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
  2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
  3. Cut in cold butter using a pastry cutter or fork until mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
  4. Gently fold in blueberries.
  5. In a separate bowl, whisk cream, egg, and vanilla. Stir into dry ingredients until just combined.
  6. Turn dough onto floured surface, shape into a 1-inch thick circle, and cut into 8 wedges.
  7. Place wedges on prepared sheet, brush with cream, and sprinkle with coarse sugar.
  8. Bake 18-22 minutes until golden. Cool before serving.

Tips

For flaky scones, keep ingredients cold and avoid over-mixing. Serve with clotted cream or lemon glaze.

result.title: Blueberry Scone Recipe | Coded Culinary
result.content:
Blueberry Scones

Yield: 8 scones | Prep time: 15 min | Bake time: 20 min

Ingredients

  • 2 cups all-purpose flour
  • 1/3 cup granulated sugar
  • 1 tbsp baking powder
  • 1/2 tsp salt
  • 1/2 cup unsalted butter, cold and cubed
  • 3/4 cup fresh blueberries
  • 1/2 cup heavy cream
  • 1 large egg
  • 1 tsp vanilla extract

Instructions

  1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
  2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
  3. Cut in cold butter using a pastry cutter or fork until mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
  4. Gently fold in blueberries.
  5. In a separate bowl, whisk cream, egg, and vanilla. Stir into dry ingredients until just combined.
  6. Turn dough onto floured surface, shape into a 1-inch thick circle, and cut into 8 wedges.
  7. Place wedges on prepared sheet, brush with cream, and sprinkle with coarse sugar.
  8. Bake 18-22 minutes until golden. Cool before serving.

Tips

For flaky scones, keep ingredients cold and avoid over-mixing. Serve with clotted cream or lemon glaze.

© 2026 Coded Culinary | Recipe last updated: 2025-11-15

result.title: Blueberry Scone Recipe | Coded Culinary
result.content:
Blueberry Scones

Yield: 8 scones | Prep time: 15 min | Bake time: 20 min

Ingredients

  • 2 cups all-purpose flour
  • 1/3 cup granulated sugar
  • 1 tbsp baking powder
  • 1/2 tsp salt
  • 1/2 cup unsalted butter, cold and cubed
  • 3/4 cup fresh blueberries
  • 1/2 cup heavy cream
  • 1 large egg
  • 1 tsp vanilla extract

Instructions

  1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
  2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
  3. Cut in cold butter using a pastry cutter or fork until mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
  4. Gently fold in blueberries.
  5. In a separate bowl, whisk cream, egg, and vanilla. Stir into dry ingredients until just combined.
  6. Turn dough onto floured surface, shape into a 1-inch thick circle, and cut into 8 wedges.
  7. Place wedges on prepared sheet, brush with cream, and sprinkle with coarse sugar.
  8. Bake 18-22 minutes until golden. Cool before serving.

Tips

For flaky scones, keep ingredients cold and avoid over-mixing. Serve with clotted cream or lemon glaze.

I've successfully navigated to the Blueberry Scones recipe on Coded Culinary! Here's the recipe:

## Blueberry Scones
**Yield:** 8 scones | **Prep time:** 15 min | **Bake time:** 20 min

### Ingredients
- 2 cups all-purpose flour
- 1/3 cup granulated sugar
- 1 tbsp baking powder
- 1/2 tsp salt
- 1/2 cup unsalted butter, cold and cubed
- 3/4 cup fresh blueberries
- 1/2 cup heavy cream
- 1 large egg
- 1 tsp vanilla extract

### Instructions
1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
3. Cut in cold butter using a pastry cutter or fork until mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
4. Gently fold in blueberries.
5. In a separate bowl, whisk cream, egg, and vanilla. Stir into dry ingredients until just combined.
6. Turn dough onto floured surface, shape into a 1-inch thick circle, and cut into 8 wedges.
7. Place wedges on prepared sheet, brush with cream, and sprinkle with coarse sugar.
8. Bake 18-22 minutes until golden. Cool before serving.

### Tips
For flaky scones, keep ingredients cold and avoid over-mixing. Serve with clotted cream or lemon glaze.

Enjoy your baking! 🫐

## Blueberry Scones
**Yield:** 8 scones | **Prep time:** 15 min | **Bake time:** 20 min

### Ingredients
- 2 cups all-purpose flour
- 1/3 cup granulated sugar
- 1 tbsp baking powder
- 1/2 tsp salt
- 1/2 cup unsalted butter, cold and cubed
- 3/4 cup fresh blueberries
- 1/2 cup heavy cream
- 1 large egg
- 1 tsp vanilla extract

### Instructions
1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.

5. In a separate bowl, whisk cream, egg, and vanilla. Stir into dry ingredients until just combined.
6. Turn dough onto floured surface, shape into a 1-inch thick circle, and cut into 8 wedges.
7. Place wedges on prepared sheet, brush with cream, and sprinkle with coarse sugar.
8. Bake 18-22 minutes until golden. Cool before serving.

### Tips
For flaky scones, keep ingredients cold and avoid over-mixing. Serve with clotted cream or lemon glaze.

result.title: Blueberry Scone Recipe | Coded Culinary
result.content:
Blueberry Scones

Yield: 8 scones | Prep time: 15 min | Bake time: 20 min

Ingredients

  • 2 cups all-purpose flour
  • 1/3 cup granulated sugar
  • 1 tbsp baking powder
  • 1/2 tsp salt
  • 1/2 cup unsalted butter, cold and cubed
  • 3/4 cup fresh blueberries
  • 1/2 cup heavy cream
  • 1 large egg
  • 1 tsp vanilla extract

Instructions

  1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
  2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
  3. Cut in cold butter using a pastry cutter or fork until mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
  4. Gently fold in blueberries.
  5. In a separate bowl, whisk cream, egg, and vanilla. Stir into dry ingredients until just combined.
  6. Turn dough onto floured surface, shape into a 1-inch thick circle, and cut into 8 wedges.
  7. Place wedges on prepared sheet, brush with cream, and sprinkle with coarse sugar.
  8. Bake 18-22 minutes until golden. Cool before serving.

Tips

For flaky scones, keep ingredients cold and avoid over-mixing. Serve with clotted cream or lemon glaze.

result.title: Blueberry Scone Recipe | Coded Culinary
result.content:
Blueberry Scones

Yield: 8 scones | Prep time: 15 min | Bake time: 20 min

Ingredients

  • 2 cups all-purpose flour
  • 1/3 cup granulated sugar
  • 1 tbsp baking powder
  • 1/2 tsp salt
  • 1/2 cup unsalted butter, cold and cubed
  • 3/4 cup fresh blueberries
  • 1/2 cup heavy cream
  • 1 large egg
  • 1 tsp vanilla extract

Instructions

  1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
  2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
  3. Cut in cold butter using a pastry cutter or fork until mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
  4. Gently fold in blueberries.
  5. In a separate bowl, whisk cream, egg, and vanilla. Stir into dry ingredients until just combined.
  6. Turn dough onto floured surface, shape into a 1-inch thick circle, and cut into 8 wedges.
  7. Place wedges on prepared sheet, brush with cream, and sprinkle with coarse sugar.
  8. Bake 18-22 minutes until golden. Cool before serving.

Tips

For flaky scones, keep ingredients cold and avoid over-mixing. Serve with clotted cream or lemon glaze.

## Blueberry Scones
**Yield:** 8 scones | **Prep time:** 15 min | **Bake time:** 20 min

### Ingredients
- 2 cups all-purpose flour
- 1/3 cup granulated sugar
- 1 tbsp baking powder
- 1/2 tsp salt
- 1/2 cup unsalted butter, cold and cubed
- 3/4 cup fresh blueberries
- 1/2 cup heavy cream
- 1 large egg
- 1 tsp vanilla extract

### Instructions
1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
3. Cut in cold butter using a pastry cutter or fork until mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
4. Gently fold in blueberries.
5. In a separate bowl, whisk cream, egg, and vanilla. Stir into dry ingredients until just combined.
6. Turn dough onto floured surface, shape into a 1-inch thick circle, and cut into 8 wedges.
7. Place wedges on prepared sheet, brush with cream, and sprinkle with coarse sugar.
8. Bake 18-22 minutes until golden. Cool before serving.

### Tips
For flaky scones, keep ingredients cold and avoid over-mixing. Serve with clotted cream or lemon glaze.

Enjoy your baking! 🫐🥐

result.title: Blueberry Scone Recipe | Coded Culinary
result.content:
Blueberry Scones

Yield: 8 scones | Prep time: 15 min | Bake time: 20 min

Ingredients

  • 2 cups all-purpose flour
  • 1/3 cup granulated sugar
  • 1 tbsp baking powder
  • 1/2 tsp salt
  • 1/2 cup unsalted butter, cold and cubed
  • 3/4 cup fresh blueberries
  • 1/2 cup heavy cream
  • 1 large egg
  • 1 tsp vanilla extract

Instructions

  1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
  2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
  3. Cut in cold butter using a pastry cutter or fork until mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
  4. Gently fold in blueberries.
  5. In a separate bowl, whisk cream, egg, and vanilla. Stir into dry ingredients until just combined.
  6. Turn dough onto floured surface, shape into a 1-inch thick circle, and cut into 8 wedges.
  7. Place wedges on prepared sheet, brush with cream, and sprinkle with coarse sugar.
  8. Bake 18-22 minutes until golden. Cool before serving.

Tips

For flaky scones, keep ingredients cold and avoid over-mixing. Serve with clotted cream or lemon glaze.

**Recipe Details:**
- Yield: 8 scones
- Prep time: 15 minutes
- Bake time: 20 minutes

**Ingredients:**
- 2 cups all-purpose flour
- 1/3 cup granulated sugar
- 1 tbsp baking powder
- 1/2 tsp salt
- 1/2 cup unsalted butter, cold and cubed
- 3/4 cup fresh blueberries
- 1/2 cup heavy cream
- 1 large egg
- 1 tsp vanilla extract

**Instructions:**
1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
3. Cut in cold butter using a pastry cutter or fork until mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
4. Gently fold in blueberries.
5. In a separate bowl, whisk cream, egg, and vanilla. Stir into dry ingredients until just combined.
6. Turn dough onto floured surface, shape into a 1-inch thick circle, and cut into 8 wedges.
7. Place wedges on prepared sheet, brush with cream, and sprinkle with coarse sugar.
8. Bake 18-22 minutes until golden. Cool before serving.

**Tips:** For flaky scones, keep ingredients cold and avoid over-mixing. Serve with clotted cream or lemon glaze.

result.title: Blueberry Scone Recipe | Coded Culinary
result.content:
Blueberry Scones

Yield: 8 scones | Prep time: 15 min | Bake time: 20 min

Ingredients

  • 2 cups all-purpose flour
  • 1/3 cup granulated sugar
  • 1 tbsp baking powder
  • 1/2 tsp salt
  • 1/2 cup unsalted butter, cold and cubed
  • 3/4 cup fresh blueberries
  • 1/2 cup heavy cream
  • 1 large egg
  • 1 tsp vanilla extract

Instructions

  1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
  2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
  3. Cut in cold butter using a pastry cutter or fork until mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
  4. Gently fold in blueberries.
  5. In a separate bowl, whisk cream, egg, and vanilla. Stir into dry ingredients until just combined.
  6. Turn dough onto floured surface, shape into a 1-inch thick circle, and cut into 8 wedges.
  7. Place wedges on prepared sheet, brush with cream, and sprinkle with coarse sugar.
  8. Bake 18-22 minutes until golden. Cool before serving.

Tips

For flaky scones, keep ingredients cold and avoid over-mixing. Serve with clotted cream or lemon glaze.

© 2026 Coded Culinary | Recipe last updated: 2025-11-15

execution_trajectory.agent_response:
I've successfully navigated to the Blueberry Scones recipe on Coded Culinary. Here's the recipe:

## Blueberry Scones
**Yield:** 8 scones | **Prep time:** 15 min | **Bake time:** 20 min

### Ingredients
- 2 cups all-purpose flour
- 1/3 cup granulated sugar
- 1 tbsp baking powder
- 1/2 tsp salt
- 1/2 cup unsalted butter, cold and cubed
- 3/4 cup fresh blueberries
- 1/2 cup heavy cream
- 1 large egg
- 1 tsp vanilla extract

### Instructions
1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
3. Cut in cold butter using a pastry cutter or fork until mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
4. Gently fold in blueberries.
5. In a separate bowl, whisk cream, egg, and vanilla. Stir into dry ingredients until just combined.
6. Turn dough onto floured surface, shape into a 1-inch thick circle, and cut into 8 wedges.
7. Place wedges on prepared sheet, brush with cream, and sprinkle with coarse sugar.
8. Bake 18-22 minutes until golden. Cool before serving.

### Tips
For flaky scones, keep ingredients cold and avoid over-mixing. Serve with clotted cream or lemon glaze.

## Blueberry Scones
**Yield:** 8 scones | **Prep time:** 15 min | **Bake time:** 20 min

### Ingredients
- 2 cups all-purpose flour
- 1/3 cup granulated sugar
- 1 tbsp baking powder
- 1/2 tsp salt
- 1/2 cup unsalted butter, cold and cubed
- 3/4 cup fresh blueberries
- 1/2 cup heavy cream
- 1 large egg
- 1 tsp vanilla extract

### Instructions
1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
3. Cut in cold butter using a pastry cutter or fork until mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
4. Gently fold in blueberries.
5. In a separate bowl, whisk cream, egg, and vanilla. Stir into dry ingredients until just combined.
6. Turn dough onto floured surface, shape into a 1-inch thick circle, and cut into 8 wedges.
7. Place wedges on prepared sheet, brush with cream, and sprinkle with coarse sugar.
8. Bake 18-22 minutes until golden. Cool before serving.

### Tips
For flaky scones, keep ingredients cold and avoid over-mixing. Serve with clotted cream or lemon glaze.

Enjoy your baking! 🫐

## Blueberry Scones
**Yield:** 8 scones | **Prep time:** 15 min | **Bake time:** 20 min

### Ingredients
- 2 cups all-purpose flour
- 1/3 cup granulated sugar
- 1 tbsp baking powder
- 1/2 tsp salt
- 1/2 cup unsalted butter, cold and cubed
- 3/4 cup fresh blueberries
- 1/2 cup heavy cream
- 1 large egg
- 1 tsp vanilla extract

### Instructions
1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
3. Cut in cold butter using a pastry cutter or fork until mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
4. Gently fold in blueberries.
5. In a separate bowl, whisk cream, egg, and vanilla. Stir into dry ingredients until just combined.
6. Turn dough onto floured surface, shape into a 1-inch thick circle, and cut into 8 wedges.
7. Place wedges on prepared sheet, brush with cream, and sprinkle with coarse sugar.
8. Bake 18-22 minutes until golden. Cool before serving.

### Tips
For flaky scones, keep ingredients cold and avoid over-mixing. Serve with clotted cream or lemon glaze.

Enjoy your baking! 🫐

## Blueberry Scones
**Yield:** 8 scones | **Prep time:** 15 min | **Bake time:** 20 min

### Ingredients
- 2 cups all-purpose flour
- 1/3 cup granulated sugar
- 1 tbsp baking powder
- 1/2 tsp salt
- 1/2 cup unsalted butter, cold and cubed
- 3/4 cup fresh blueberries
- 1/2 cup heavy cream
- 1 large egg
- 1 tsp vanilla extract

### Instructions
1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
3. Cut in cold butter using a pastry cutter or fork until mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
4. Gently fold in blueberries.
5. In a separate bowl, whisk cream, egg, and vanilla. Stir into dry ingredients until just combined.
6. Turn dough onto floured surface, shape into a 1-inch thick circle, and cut into 8 wedges.
7. Place wedges on prepared sheet, brush with cream, and sprinkle with coarse sugar.
8. Bake 18-22 minutes until golden. Cool before serving.

### Tips
For flaky scones, keep ingredients cold and avoid over-mixing. Serve with clotted cream or lemon glaze.

execution_trajectory.agent_response:
I've successfully navigated to the Blueberry Scones recipe on Coded Culinary! Here's the recipe:

## Blueberry Scones
**Yield:** 8 scones | **Prep time:** 15 min | **Bake time:** 20 min

### Ingredients
- 2 cups all-purpose flour
- 1/3 cup granulated sugar
- 1 tbsp baking powder
- 1/2 tsp salt
- 1/2 cup unsalted butter, cold and cubed
- 3/4 cup fresh blueberries
- 1/2 cup heavy cream
- 1 large egg
- 1 tsp vanilla extract

### Instructions
1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
3. Cut in cold butter using a pastry cutter or fork until mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
4. Gently fold in blueberries.
5. In a separate bowl, whisk cream, egg, and vanilla. Stir into dry ingredients until just combined.
6. Turn dough onto floured surface, shape into a 1-inch thick circle, and cut into 8 wedges.
7. Place wedges on prepared sheet, brush with cream, and sprinkle with coarse sugar.
8. Bake 18-22 minutes until golden. Cool before serving.

### Tips
For flaky scones, keep ingredients cold and avoid over-mixing. Serve with clotted cream or lemon glaze.

Enjoy your baking! 🫐

## Blueberry Scones
**Yield:** 8 scones | **Prep time:** 15 min | **Bake time:** 20 min

### Ingredients
- 2 cups all-purpose flour
- 1/3 cup granulated sugar
- 1 tbsp baking powder
- 1/2 tsp salt
- 1/2 cup unsalted butter, cold and cubed
- 3/4 cup fresh blueberries
- 1/2 cup heavy cream
- 1 large egg
- 1 tsp vanilla extract

### Instructions
1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.

For flaky scones, keep ingredients cold and avoid over-mixing. Serve with clotted cream or lemon glaze.

execution_trajectory.agent_response:
I've successfully navigated to the Blueberry Scones recipe on Coded Culinary! Here's the recipe:

## Blueberry Scones
**Yield:** 8 scones | **Prep time:** 15 min | **Bake time:** 20 min

### Ingredients
- 2 cups all-purpose flour
- 1/3 cup granulated sugar
- 1 tbsp baking powder
- 1/2 tsp salt
- 1/2 cup unsalted butter, cold and cubed
- 3/4 cup fresh blueberries
- 1/2 cup heavy cream
- 1 large egg
- 1 tsp vanilla extract

### Instructions
1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
3. Cut in cold butter using a pastry cutter or fork until mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
4. Gently fold in blueberries.
5. In a separate bowl, whisk cream, egg, and vanilla. Stir into dry ingredients until just combined.
6. Turn dough onto floured surface, shape into a 1-inch thick circle, and cut into 8 wedges.
7. Place wedges on prepared sheet, brush with cream, and sprinkle with coarse sugar.
8. Bake 18-22 minutes until golden. Cool before serving.

### Tips
For flaky scones, keep ingredients cold and avoid over-mixing. Serve with clotted cream or lemon glaze.

Enjoy your baking! 🫐🧁

execution_trajectory.agent_response:
I've successfully navigated to the Blueberry Scones recipe on Coded Culinary. Here's the recipe:

## Blueberry Scones
**Yield:** 8 scones | **Prep time:** 15 min | **Bake time:** 20 min

### Ingredients
- 2 cups all-purpose flour
- 1/3 cup granulated sugar
- 1 tbsp baking powder
- 1/2 tsp salt
- 1/2 cup unsalted butter, cold and cubed
- 3/4 cup fresh blueberries
- 1/2 cup heavy cream
- 1 large egg
- 1 tsp vanilla extract

### Instructions
1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
3. Cut in cold butter using a pastry cutter or fork until mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
4. Gently fold in blueberries.
5. In a separate bowl, whisk cream, egg, and vanilla. Stir into dry ingredients until just combined.
6. Turn dough onto floured surface, shape into a 1-inch thick circle, and cut into 8 wedges.
7. Place wedges on prepared sheet, brush with cream, and sprinkle with coarse sugar.
8. Bake 18-22 minutes until golden. Cool before serving.

### Tips
For flaky scones, keep ingredients cold and avoid over-mixing. Serve with clotted cream or lemon glaze.

*Recipe last updated: 2025-11-15*

result.title: Blueberry Scone Recipe | Coded Culinary
result.content:
Blueberry Scones

Yield: 8 scones | Prep time: 15 min | Bake time: 20 min

Ingredients

  • 2 cups all-purpose flour
  • 1/3 cup granulated sugar
  • 1 tbsp baking powder
  • 1/2 tsp salt
  • 1/2 cup unsalted butter, cold and cubed
  • 3/4 cup fresh blueberries
  • 1/2 cup heavy cream
  • 1 large egg
  • 1 tsp vanilla extract

Instructions

  1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
  2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
  3. Cut in cold butter using a pastry cutter or fork until mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
  4. Gently fold in blueberries.
  5. In a separate bowl, whisk cream, egg, and vanilla. Stir into dry ingredients until just combined.
  6. Turn dough onto floured surface, shape into a 1-inch thick circle, and cut into 8 wedges.
  7. Place wedges on prepared sheet, brush with cream, and sprinkle with coarse sugar.
  8. Bake 18-22 minutes until golden. Cool before serving.

Tips

For flaky scones, keep ingredients cold and avoid over-mixing. Serve with clotted cream or lemon glaze.

## Key Points - Q1 2025 OKRs

**Objective 1: Enhance Core Platform Performance**
- Key Result 1.1: Achieve 99.9% API uptime (Actual: 99.92%)
- Key Result 1.2: Reduce median page load time to 2.1s (Actual: 2.05s)
- Key Result 1.3: Decrease error rate to <0.5% (Actual: 0.42%)

**Objective 2: Expand User Base in Europe**
- Key Result 2.1: Acquire 25,000 new users (Actual: 28,500)
- Key Result 2.2: Launch German-language support (Completed: Feb 15, 2025)
- Key Result 2.3: Secure 3 major enterprise partnerships (Achieved: 4 partnerships)

**Objective 3: Improve Developer Experience**
- Key Result 3.1: Release SDK v2.0 (Completed: Mar 10, 2025)
- Key Result 3.2: Reduce onboarding time to 30 minutes (Actual: 28 minutes)
- Key Result 3.3: Achieve 95% satisfaction score in developer survey (Actual: 96%)

**Summary**: Q1 2025 targets exceeded across all objectives. Platform stability improved significantly while European expansion surpassed growth goals. Developer tools adoption increased with positive feedback.

I've successfully navigated to the Blueberry Scones recipe on Coded Culinary. Here's what I found:

**Blueberry Scones Recipe**
- **Yield:** 8 scones
- **Prep time:** 15 minutes
- **Bake time:** 20 minutes

**Ingredients:**
- 2 cups all-purpose flour
- 1/3 cup granulated sugar
- 1 tbsp baking powder
- 1/2 tsp salt
- 1/2 cup unsalted butter, cold and cubed
- 3/4 cup fresh blueberries
- 1/2 cup heavy cream
- 1 large egg
- 1 tsp vanilla extract

**Instructions:**
1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
2. Whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt in a large bowl.
3. Cut in cold butter until mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
4. Gently fold in blueberries.
5. Whisk cream, egg, and vanilla in a separate bowl, then stir into dry ingredients until just combined.
6. Shape dough into a 1-inch thick circle on a floured surface and cut into 8 wedges.
7. Place wedges on the baking sheet, brush with cream, and sprinkle with coarse sugar.
8. Bake 18-22 minutes until golden. Cool before serving.

**Tip:** For flaky scones, keep ingredients cold and avoid over-mixing. Serve with clotted cream or lemon glaze.

result.content:
Blueberry Scones

Yield: 8 scones | Prep time: 15 min | Bake time: 20 min

Ingredients

  • 2 cups all-purpose flour
  • 1/3 cup granulated sugar
  • 1 tbsp baking powder
  • 1/2 tsp salt
  • 1/2 cup unsalted butter, cold and cubed
  • 3/4 cup fresh blueberries
  • 1/2 cup heavy cream
  • 1 large egg
  • 1 tsp vanilla extract

Instructions

  1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
  2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
  3. Cut in cold butter using a pastry cutter or fork until mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
  4. Gently fold in blueberries.
  5. In a separate bowl, whisk cream, egg, and vanilla. Stir into dry ingredients until just combined.
  6. Turn dough onto floured surface, shape into a 1-inch thick circle, and cut into 8 wedges.
  7. Place wedges on prepared sheet, brush with cream, and sprinkle with coarse sugar.
  8. Bake 18-22 minutes until golden. Cool before serving.

Tips

For flaky scones, keep ingredients cold and avoid over-mixing. Serve with clotted cream or lemon glaze.

## Blueberry Scones
**Yield:** 8 scones | **Prep time:** 15 min | **Bake time:** 20 min

### Ingredients
- 2 cups all-purpose flour
- 1/3 cup granulated sugar
- 1 tbsp baking powder
- 1/2 tsp salt
- 1/2 cup unsalted butter, cold and cubed
- 3/4 cup fresh blueberries
- 1/2 cup heavy cream
- 1 large egg
- 1 tsp vanilla extract

### Instructions
1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
3. Cut in cold butter using a pastry cutter or fork until mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
4. Gently fold in blueberries.
5. In a separate bowl, whisk cream, egg, and vanilla. Stir into dry ingredients until just combined.
6. Turn dough onto floured surface, shape into a 1-inch thick circle, and cut into 8 wedges.
7. Place wedges on prepared sheet, brush with cream, and sprinkle with coarse sugar.
8. Bake 18-22 minutes until golden. Cool before serving.

### Tips
For flaky scones, keep ingredients cold and avoid over-mixing. Serve with clotted cream or lemon glaze.

Enjoy your baking! 🫐🥐
